items.title: Auto Shot and special-shot timing
items.question: Does current Forever retain the Classic half-second Auto Shot wind-up and interactions with Aimed/Sniper/Multi-Shot?
items.current_model: Classic half-second Auto Shot wind-up when idle; in Forever, Auto Shot also fires during Aimed Shot, Multi-Shot and Sniper Shot casts as an instant shot that leaves the special's cast and completion intact. Specials do not reset the ranged timer.
items.impact: All ranged Hunter comparisons and haste value.

review.answer: Three independent sources now agree, and the earlier reading of #76 as a sound report missed its resolution. On forever-bugs#76 (2026-09-23) a reply states 'Confirming that you are meant to be able to Auto Shot during those actions' (Aimed Shot, Multi-Shot, Sniper Shot); the same contributor relays upcoming fix schedules elsewhere (#279). The cited forever-hunter wiki says 'Auto Shot can fire while the Hunter is casting another spell with a cast time', and beta players report the same (Hunter Lodge, 2026-10-06 to 10-09). In the client, Aimed Shot drops the Combat interrupt flag (Era 15, Forever 7), carries DO_NOT_RESET_COMBAT_TIMERS and gains SPELL_ATTR4_IGNORE_COMBAT_TIMER.
review.remaining: The wiki also reports melee attacks resetting the ranged timer (intent unclear); not modelled.
review.implementation: Implemented: the three shots carry SpellFlagAllowAutoAttacks under Forever; Auto Shot may cast during them with zero wind-up. Paired impact: Marksmanship +12.9%, Beast Mastery +3.6% on top of the RAP change (totals vs the published engine +16.2% / +5.1%).

items.title: Ice Lance coefficient and frozen multiplier
items.question: What is the Ice Lance SP coefficient at each rank, and does the frozen multiplier cover the whole hit?

review.answer: Processed public event reports 2727/2687 independently favor about 0.10–0.11 over the old 0.143 guess. Frostbolt-derived SP and repeated low Ice Lance hits constrain the fit. The 0.10 working model replaces that guess, but gear/talent details and resist/absorb fields are incomplete. October 11 audit: WoWSims #forever-mage (2026-10-08/09): Ice Lance rank 2 measured at about 0.113 SP (95% range 0.109–0.118) from 0 versus 58/71 SP logs; rank 1 at about 0.095 (0.089–0.100, 79 hits). Neither matches 1/7. The provisional 0.10 sits between the measured low ranks; the level-60 rank is unmeasured and probabilistic damage rounding widens the intervals. tests.requires: Level-20 Mage with Ice Lance, two SP totals and a rootable controlled target.

items.title: Instant Maelstrom Lightning Bolt swing reset
items.question: Does a five-stack instant Bolt still reset the next melee swing?
items.current_model: The recent beta evidence supports instant Lightning Bolt preserving melee swings. Instant LB/CL no longer reset a full swing; positive-time casts still defer melee to cast end plus a full swing, with no melee during casts. Maelstrom only discounts/consumes on Lightning Bolt. Native instant/hardcast controls pass.
items.impact: Enhancement APL rankings; all corrected research includes the reset.

review.answer: Server semantics settle the model. Lightning Bolt and Chain Lightning carry the Combat interrupt flag (SpellInterrupts 15) and SPELL_ATTR6_DOESNT_RESET_SWING_TIMER_IF_INSTANT (0x02000000), and lack DO_NOT_RESET_COMBAT_TIMERS. TrinityCore's Spell::IsAutoActionResetSpell resets combat timers at cast completion unless the spell is instant with that attribute. So an instant (five-stack) cast keeps the swing timer and any positive cast time resets it, exactly as modelled.
review.remaining: A combat trace would only confirm, not change, the rule.
review.implementation: Corrected locally with focused native controls; affected exact profiles and published results require refresh before these changes are released.

tests.requires: Level-39+ Shaman with five-point Maelstrom and a recorded swing timer.
tests.measure: Cast five-stack Bolt at multiple points in the swing cycle, then compare ordinary and partial-stack casts. Record start, completion and next auto, not only aggregate DPS.

items.title: Energy refunds on avoided attacks
items.question: Which builders and finishers refund Energy on miss, dodge or parry, and what fraction of the paid cost returns?
items.current_model: Forever finishers refund 80% of their paid Energy on a miss, dodge or parry, like builders: Eviscerate, Rupture, Expose Armor, Rip and Ferocious Bite. Combo points are spent only on a landed finisher.
items.impact: Feral and Rogue resource supply, especially before hit cap or when attacking from the front.

review.answer: The earlier review misread the client. Every player rank of Eviscerate (2098–31016), Rupture, Slice and Dice, Expose Armor, Rip (1079–9896) and Ferocious Bite (22568–31018) carries SPELL_ATTR1_DISCOUNT_POWER_ON_MISS (0x08000000) in 70009 and 70338. The ids without it are cost-free NPC or internal records with no skill line (1271520, 1271514, 1272982, 1289141, 1289142). In Era only builders carry the bit, and builders refund 80%; Forever extends the same attribute to finishers. Primal Bite, Claw, Rake, Shred, Maul and Lacerate have it; Swipe and the retained Mangle ids do not. October 11 audit: Rogue beta testers corroborate the finisher refund: 'parries or dodges refund cps and most energy' and 'energy refunds are in for everything' (Rogue Classic Discord, 2026-09-28/29). The same tester said misses do not refund, which differs from Classic's builder rule and from the engine (which refunds on any avoided outcome); that single statement is recorded, not adopted.
review.remaining: Whether a miss (as opposed to dodge/parry) refunds, and the exact fraction ('most').
review.implementation: Implemented: Forever finishers use Refund 0.8 (eviscerate.go, rupture.go, expose_armor.go, rip.go, ferocious_bite.go).

items.title: Slam swing timer and Improved Slam cooldown
items.question: Does untalented Forever Slam interrupt melee swings, and how much cooldown does Improved Slam remove?
items.current_model: Untalented Slam: no autos during the cast; both swings restart from its completion. Improved Slam: autos continue and no reset. 18-second cooldown, 15 seconds with either rank of Improved Slam.
items.impact: All Warrior DPS rotations that cast Slam; the Fury and Arms benchmark rotations.

review.answer: The 'Panel' rule that Slam no longer resets the swing timer is not what the client ships. Untalented ranks (1240193, 1464, 8820, 11604, 11605) keep InterruptFlags 15 (including Combat) and lack SPELL_ATTR2_DO_NOT_RESET_COMBAT_TIMERS, like Era's Slam. Improved Slam (12862) overrides every rank (aura 332) with 1310196–1310200, which have InterruptFlags 7 and set DO_NOT_RESET_COMBAT_TIMERS; its text says 'In addition, Slam no longer interrupts or delays your melee swing'. Its cooldown modifier is −3000 ms at both ranks (curve [0.25, 3], [0.5, 3]); the engine had 1.5 s per point.
review.remaining: None.
review.implementation: Implemented in slam.go with a cast-speed-correct reset; regression TestForeverSlamSwingTimerDependsOnImprovedSlam. The benchmark Warrior rotations still cast Slam at 30 (15 for Arms) Rage; with the corrected engine, Fury and Fury (Sunder) gain 4.5%/4.3% without Slam, and Arms/2H Bloodthirst 2.0%/0.7% with a 50-Rage gate.

items.title: Talent modifier scope versus client class masks
items.question: Do simulated talents apply their damage, crit, hit and cost modifiers to the same spells as the client's class masks?
items.current_model: Talent modifiers follow the client masks for every benchmark talent checked; exceptions are listed in the answer.
items.impact: Shadow and Smite Priest, Marksmanship and Beast Mastery, and Warriors using Rend.

review.answer: Differential audit, October 11: each benchmark build was constructed with and without every talent it takes (583 variants). The spells whose static modifiers changed were compared with the spells covered by the talent's client modifier masks (aura 107/108, ops damage, periodic, crit, crit damage, hit, cost, cast, cooldown and GCD). Defects found and fixed: Twin Disciplines applied to every instant Priest spell, including Mind Flay, Shadow Word: Death, Starshards and Penance, while the mask covers Shadow Word: Pain, Devouring Plague and Holy Nova; a tester also found it does not affect Mind Flay. Holy Precision, Holy Specialization and Mental Agility applied to Penance (and Mental Agility to Shadow Word: Death), which their masks exclude. Mortal Shots applied to Sniper Shot, Raptor Strike, Mongoose Bite and Wing Clip but not Serpent Sting; the mask is Auto/Aimed/Multi/Arcane/Serpent/Volley. Impale did not reach Rend's crits, which its mask includes. Investigated and correct: Elemental Fury on Searing/Magma totems (the mask includes their attack spells), Aftermath and Improved Seals (applied at cast or on the proc spell). Low-impact mismatches recorded but not changed: Genesis and Survival Tactics on AoE-only spells, Call of Flame on Fire Nova, Malediction's Soul Fire scope, and Paladin seal cost reductions (Paladins are never mana-limited in the benchmark).
review.remaining: Dynamic (aura-based) talent effects are outside a static differential check.
review.implementation: Fixed under Forever only; Classic behaviour unchanged.

No log carries a Cat PPM proc, so the PPM rule is inferred from that. Before this change, 15 proc-trigger effects used the weapon speed on special attacks while Crusader, Fiery Weapon and the 53 weapon-proc helpers used 1.0.
review.remaining: Measured PPM proc counts per Cat special attack with a slow weapon.

items.title: Forever consumables
items.question: Which Forever consumables apply, and do elixir crit riders stack?
items.current_model: Merchant's Favor elixirs (Ferocity, Cunning, Grizzly, Owl, Sages) and potions (Major Spellblasting, Major Frenzy), Swiftstrike Steak and Prehistoric Pulled Raptor, Scroll of Imbue Precision/Accuracy beside stones and oils. One elixir's 2% crit applies, to attacks and spells. Elemental Sharpening Stone (a Molten Core recipe) is left out.
items.impact: Every build's consumables were re-picked by simulation.

review.answer: Client 1.60.1.70450 item and spell rows; wowsims/forever #209 (one elixir crit) and its elixir groups.
review.remaining: Whether elixirs of different groups stack in game, and the Scroll of Imbue source.
review.implementation: Elixirs grouped by first stat.

tests.requires: Two crit elixirs.
tests.measure: Character-sheet crit with each and both.

items.title: Warrior threat values
items.question: What flat threat do Heroic Strike, Cleave and Sunder Armor add, and how is rage threat counted?
items.current_model: Heroic Strike 2.54 x spell level, Cleave 1.53 x spell level split between the targets it lands on, Sunder Armor flat + 0.05 AP; rage threat 5 per rage x the threat multiplier when gained, split between enemies.
items.impact: Tank threat; Fury/Arms TPS.

review.answer: wowsims/forever #264/#385: an addon reading the threat table against the combat log; the published threat sheet agrees at Heroic Strike rank 4 and Cleave rank 2.
review.remaining: Level-60 ranks.
review.implementation: Anger Management stays 1 rage per 3 s: Era carries the same aura row and gives 1 per 3 s (wowsims/forever #494 reads it as 1.5 per 5 s).

tests.requires: Level-60 Warrior with a threat meter.
tests.measure: Threat per landed Heroic Strike rank 8.

items.title: Bloodthrill procs
items.question: Which attacks proc Bloodthrill, and how long is the Overpower window?
items.current_model: Main-hand white swings (extra attacks included) and the queued Heroic Strike/Cleave; 5 s window.
items.impact: Arms Overpower count.

review.answer: Forever logs: 24 bystander procs all from those; 0 from off-hand swings, Hamstring, Overpower, Execute (wowsims/forever #534); server hotfix DurationIndex 28 (5 s).
review.remaining: None.
review.implementation: Main-hand auto mask, which the queued Heroic Strike and Cleave carry.

items.title: Seal of Righteousness and One-Handed Weapon Specialization
items.question: How does Seal of Righteousness scale with weapon speed, and what does One-Handed Weapon Specialization reach?
items.current_model: Seal of Righteousness per hit: value/100 x speed x 1.2 (two-hander, 0.12 SP) or x (0.85 - 0.2 x max(0, 2 - speed)) (one-hander, 0.10 SP). One-Handed Weapon Specialization raises every school except Consecration, Retribution Aura and Holy Shock; Two-Handed stays Physical.
items.impact: Retribution, Shockadin and Protection Paladin.

review.answer: wowsims/forever #110 (eighteen weapons measured); Ashreon's in-game measurement on 70425 (MythicSim patches 143/149).
review.remaining: Judgement of Righteousness and Holy Strike coefficients remain disputed (0.429 rows against 0.70/0.286 measured); the rows are kept.
review.implementation: Forever ruleset; the one-hander rule pays the specialization through the school multipliers.

tests.requires: Level-60 Paladin, 1H and shield.
tests.measure: Judgement and Holy Strike hits with and without 50 spell power.

items.title: Survival melee weave
items.question: How much does a melee weave gain, and what do traps and Strider Kick add?
items.current_model: SV Weave steps from 12 to 5 yards while the next Auto Shot is more than 1.5 s away; traps take 13% of the higher of ranged and melee Attack Power (Explosive Trap's explosion only); Strider Kick speeds the hunter 30% for 3 s.
items.impact: Hunter ranking; SV Weave leads Survival by about 20%.

review.answer: wowsims/forever and MythicSim SV Weave presets; trap scaling measured in game on 70425 (MythicSim patch 147); Strider Kick's speed from the client row and the 24 September notes.
review.remaining: The engine's run speed and stepping cost; no latency is modelled.
review.implementation: New build key survival_weave on the Survival equipment model.

tests.requires: Level-60 Survival Hunter weaving.
tests.measure: Auto Shots and melee abilities per minute over a five-minute fight.

items.title: Hotfixed Frost tree
items.question: What do Winter's Chill, Ice Barrier and Missile Barrage do after the 20 October hotfix?
items.current_model: Winter's Chill from Frostbolt and Fingers of Frost Ice Lance only, +5% damage and +0.07 coefficient a stack on the next Cone of Cold, stacks to the talent rank; Ice Barrier and Frigid Power each +3% Frost damage; Missile Barrage not from Arcane Missiles; Piercing Ice removed.
items.impact: Frost and Arcane Mage.

review.answer: Hotfixed tooltips and rows (game cache push 112753); wowsims/forever #594 and #479.
review.remaining: Frost Blast is not simulated (a weak utility spell).
review.implementation: Name-based Frost tree layout (ForeverTalentTreeFields).

items.title: Earth Shock and Stormstrike
items.question: Does Earth Shock spend Stormstrike's charge?
items.current_model: No: it takes the +20% and leaves the charge for the next Lightning Bolt or Chain Lightning.
items.impact: Enhancement.

review.answer: In-game beta testing relayed on 16 October 2026 (MythicSim patch 140).
review.remaining: A log with both.
review.implementation: Only Lightning Bolt and Chain Lightning spend the charge.

items.title: Marksmanship and Beast Mastery melee weave
items.question: Do the ranged Hunter trees gain from weaving Raptor Strike between Auto Shots, as Survival does?
items.current_model: MM Weave (0/28/23 with Expose Prey and Strider Kick, own Hunter's Mark, no pet) and BM Weave (31/20/0, Cat and two Hawks) step from 12 to 5 yards while the next Auto Shot is more than 1.5 s away, on the SV Weave gear.
items.impact: Both trees rank about 11-13% higher than standing at range; turret presets stay in the UI.

review.answer: wowsims/forever ships MM Weave and BM Weave presets; the sim's own runs agree.
review.remaining: Movement uses the engine's run speed with no latency; real weaving loses some swings.
review.implementation: Bench builds marksmanship and beast_mastery.

tests.requires: Level-60 MM or BM Hunter with a slow melee weapon.
tests.measure: Damage over 5 minutes weaving against standing at range on the same dummy.

items.title: Hamstring weave for Windfury Totem
items.question: Is a Hamstring between Bloodthirst and Whirlwind worth its rage for the extra Windfury Totem procs?
items.current_model: Fury, Fury (Sunder) and 2H Bloodthirst cast Hamstring when Bloodthirst and Whirlwind are at least 1.5 s away and the next main-hand swing at least 1 s away, outside execute, with Windfury Totem up. Arms does not (it lost 30-115 DPS in every placement tried).
items.impact: Fury +18, Fury (Sunder) +12, 2H Bloodthirst +31 DPS.

review.answer: wowsims/forever #243: every landed special rolls Windfury Totem's 20%; Hamstring is the cheapest. The swing condition came from the October 21 Warrior rotations (WAR-028): +1.4 DPS on Fury.
review.remaining: Depends on the provisional Warrior rage model.
review.implementation: APL only.

tests.requires: Fury Warrior with Windfury Totem.
tests.measure: Windfury procs and damage with and without the Hamstring weave.

items.title: Consecration crits, Sanctified Judgement refund, Consecrated Ground window
items.question: Do Consecration's ticks crit, how much does Sanctified Judgement return, and how long does Consecrated Ground last?
items.current_model: Forever Consecration ticks roll spell crit after the hit check; Sanctified Judgement returns its share of the seal's base cost x (2 - the percent cost modifier); Consecrated Ground's mark lasts from the cast to 0.6 s past the last tick.
items.impact: Small: Ret mana and Prot/Holy Consecration damage.

review.answer: wowsims/forever #124 (tick crits for 1.5x in game), #507 (59.4 mana at Benediction 5/5, measured at every rank), #516 (log of the hidden mark 1280353).
review.remaining: Two percent cost cuts (Benediction and Twist of Light) are added, not measured together.
review.implementation: Forever ruleset only.

tests.requires: Level-60 Paladin with the talents.
tests.measure: Consecration crit ticks and Sanctified Judgement refunds in a log.

items.title: Arcane Missiles Clearcasting and area tick crits
items.question: Do Arcane Missiles' missiles roll Arcane Concentration, and can Blizzard and Flamestrike ticks crit?
items.current_model: No Clearcasting from the missiles (nor the channel). Blizzard and Flamestrike burn ticks roll crit (the burn does not feed Ignite).
items.impact: Arcane loses some Clearcasting; area damage gains crits.

review.answer: wowsims/forever #489: 0 Clearcasting gains from 34 Arcane Missiles casts; tick rows lack ATTR_EX_2_CANT_CRIT and logs show tick crits.
review.remaining: None known.
review.implementation: Forever ruleset only.

tests.requires: Mage with Arcane Concentration.
tests.measure: Clearcasting gains per Arcane Missiles cast.

items.title: Party buffs from other players
items.question: Which party buffs from other players should the sim offer?
items.current_model: Dark Inspiration (a Shadow Priest's talent ranks: +3% Spirit a rank, kept up permanently), Mana Tide Totem (count), Darkspear's Ancestor's Vengeance (4% crit at a 16% uptime) and Admiral's Hat (+10 Stamina). All off by default; Concentration Aura is not offered (interrupts are not modelled).
items.impact: Opt-in; the benchmark does not use them.

review.remaining: Darkspear's wielder is not simulated (fixed uptime).
review.implementation: UI inputs only.

tests.requires: A party with these providers.
tests.measure: Buff uptime in a log.

items.title: Fury rotation rules learned by reinforcement learning
items.question: Which choices does the Fury rotation miss?
items.current_model: Benchmark Fury and Fury (Sunder), against the Dragonkin reference boss: talents 20/31/0 (Spearing Strike instead of Improved Bloodrage, Improved Heroic Strike 3/3 instead of two Enrage points); Bloodrage 10 s and Death Wish 1.5 s before the pull; Heroic Strike from 42 rage, checked first; Overpower and Spearing Strike in Battle Stance up to 35 rage during an Overpower window; Rend refreshed in Battle Stance up to 30 rage outside execute, staying in Battle Stance up to 75 rage while Rend is down; Hamstring with Bloodthirst and Whirlwind at least 1 s away and the next main-hand swing at least 0.7 s away; Demonic Rune at up to 40 rage. Fury (Sunder) puts Sunder Armor upkeep first. Fury Orc casts Blood Fury at -0.1 s and then at 50 rage or more; Fury Night Elf casts Elune's Light from 15 s. The site's general Fury and Fury (Sunder) presets use 19/31/1 and the same rules without Spearing Strike. 2H Bloodthirst: dance up to 60 rage, Heroic Strike from 80.
items.impact: October 28: against the Dragonkin boss, Fury +17.6 to +19.8 and Fury (Sunder) +27.9 to +29.4 DPS over the October 21 rules on every race; the general presets gain +8.4 to +9.6 and +20.4 to +21.6 on any target, and beat the Spearing Strike builds by about 5 DPS against other targets. Fury racial rules: Orc +0.7, Night Elf +2.2 DPS. October 21: Fury +23 (rotation +22, talents +1.5), Fury (Sunder) +19, 2H Bloodthirst +36 DPS.

review.answer: A policy network that chose every action in the engine beat the published rotation; its differences, written as APL rules and confirmed on 4,096 paired fights each, give these gains. The network itself stays about 6 DPS ahead. On October 28 a simulator search by several agents found Spearing Strike, a Rend stance dance and an earlier Heroic Strike; the result held on independent paired fights for all ten races, and the same rules with Sunder upkeep first kept full Sunder coverage.
review.remaining: Depends on the provisional Warrior rage model, stance-swap rage retention and WAR-029; the network's finer swing timing is not captured.
review.implementation: APLs and the Fury talent preset.

tests.requires: Level-60 Fury Warrior.
tests.measure: Overpower casts and damage in the execute phase with and without the dance.

items.title: Demonic Rune self-damage gives a Warrior rage
items.question: Does Demonic Rune's 600-1000 self-damage (spell 16666's second effect) give a Warrior rage like other damage taken?
items.current_model: Yes: the self-hit is damage taken under the measured rule (WAR-003), so Fury rotations use the Rune at up to 60 rage.
items.impact: About +2 DPS for Fury builds.

review.answer: The self-damage effect is client data (wowsims/forever #64); damage taken giving rage is standard.
review.remaining: Not observed in a Forever log.
review.implementation: Consumables (sim/core/consumes.go); APL use only.

tests.requires: Warrior with a Demonic Rune.
tests.measure: Rage before and after using the Rune out of combat or between pulls.

items.title: Imbue scrolls are Mage-only
items.question: Can classes other than Mage use the Scrolls of Imbue (277502 Precision, 277494 Accuracy)?
items.current_model: No. The engine ignores both scrolls for other classes, and the consumable picker offers them only to Mages.
items.impact: Non-Mage builds lose the scroll's 1% crit per weapon: about 0.8% DPS with one weapon and 1.6% dual-wielding.

review.answer: Client item data gives both scrolls AllowableClass 128 (Mage).
review.remaining: None.
review.implementation: Mage-only in the engine and the picker; frozen benchmark inputs no longer carry them for other classes.

items.title: Pet hit at the 17:8 ratio
items.question: How do Hunter pets and Warlock demons inherit hit from their owner?
items.current_model: Hunter pets get the Hunter's ranged hit as melee hit and 17/8 of it as spell hit; demons get the Warlock's spell hit as spell hit and 8/17 of it as melee hit.
items.impact: The Succubus's melee hit falls from about 16% to 7.5%. Cats cast no spells.

review.answer: A developer statement in the Forever bug tracker gives the 17:8 ratio.
review.remaining: Not measured in a Forever log.
review.implementation: Pet stat inheritance (sim/core/forever_pet_stats.go).

tests.requires: A Warlock with a Succubus and known spell hit, attacking a level-63 target.
tests.measure: The Succubus's melee miss rate over a few hundred swings, against 8/17 of the Warlock's spell hit.

items.title: Explosives thrown during the global cooldown
items.question: Can Autocast throw an engineering explosive while the global cooldown runs?
items.current_model: Yes, if what is left of the global cooldown covers the explosive's cast. The RL environment's emulation uses the same rule.
items.impact: Same seed: Fire +1.05%, 2H Bloodthirst +0.56%, Frostfire +0.42%; other builds within 0.2%.

review.answer: Explosives are off the global cooldown; wowsims/forever #621 and #627 throw them inside it.
review.remaining: Not timed in a Forever log.
review.implementation: Autocast Other Cooldowns.

items.title: Ranks of one damage-over-time spell on a target
items.question: Do two ranks of the same caster damage-over-time spell stack on one target?
items.current_model: No. Applying one rank removes any other rank of the same spell from that target. Channels are not affected.
items.impact: Rotations cannot gain by alternating ranks of Corruption, Immolate, Shadow Word: Pain and similar spells.

review.answer: Answered by Jordan on 27 October: ranks do not stack.
review.remaining: None.
review.implementation: Dot.replaceOtherRanks in sim/core/dot.go, with a regression test.

items.title: Traps laid before the pull
items.question: Does a trap laid before the pull go off when the fight starts?
items.current_model: Yes. A trap laid at -60 s or later goes off at 0 at any distance; its cooldown starts when it is laid.
items.impact: Hunter openers can pre-trap with Immolation, Explosive, Freezing and Frost Trap.

review.answer: Answered by Jordan on 27 October: Hunters can pre-trap.
review.remaining: None.
review.implementation: layTrapBeforePull in sim/hunter/utility.go.

items.title: Lower Arcane Wrath ranks
items.question: Can a Mage cast lower ranks of Arcane Wrath?
items.current_model: Yes. Every rank is castable and all ranks share one 6-second cooldown.
items.impact: Rotations may cast a lower rank; the Arcane preset casts the lowest.

review.answer: Answered by Jordan on 27 October.
review.remaining: None.
review.implementation: registerArcaneWrathRank in sim/mage/arcane_blast.go.

items.title: Pre-pull actions that reach the enemy
items.question: Which pre-pull actions start the fight early?
items.current_model: Anything that reaches the enemy before 0 (a hit, miss, tick or aura such as a curse) is flagged on the pre-pull action responsible, because in the game it starts the fight. Hunter's Mark, Battle Shout's threat and fire totem placement are exempt. Damage before 0 is not counted in any case.
items.impact: Searches reject flagged rotations, so pre-casts are timed to land at or after 0.

review.answer: Jordan: fire totem placement does not start the fight; the rest follows the game's rule that contact pulls.
review.remaining: Whether any other effect is pull-safe in the game.
review.implementation: Environment.notePrepullContact in sim/core/apl.go.

items.title: Rage decay before the pull
items.question: Does rage decay out of combat before the pull, and how fast?
items.current_model: Not modelled: rage gained before the pull is kept. Searches quarantine Bloodrage earlier than -10 s, and published rotations use it no earlier than -10 s.
items.impact: An early Bloodrage would otherwise carry its full rage into the fight.

review.answer: Unanswered.
review.remaining: The decay rate out of combat.
review.implementation: None yet.

tests.requires: A Warrior out of combat with Bloodrage.
tests.measure: Rage every second for 20 s after Bloodrage ends.

items.title: Auto Shot wind-up and haste
items.question: Does ranged haste shorten Auto Shot's wind-up?
items.current_model: Yes in this simulator. Upstream wowsims/forever says it does not, without citing evidence.
items.impact: Changes Hunter weave timing under Rapid Fire and other haste.

review.answer: Unanswered.
review.remaining: Wind-up length with and without haste.
review.implementation: None yet.

tests.requires: A Hunter with Rapid Fire, recording with timestamps.
tests.measure: Time from the start of the wind-up to the shot leaving, with and without Rapid Fire.

items.title: Off-hand swing after Attack is pressed
items.question: Does the off hand wait half a swing after Attack is pressed?
items.current_model: No in this simulator: the off hand swings on arrival. Upstream wowsims/forever delays it for Hunters, without citing evidence.
items.impact: About 136 DPS for SV Weave.

review.answer: Unanswered.
review.remaining: The off hand's first swing time.
review.implementation: None yet.

tests.requires: A dual-wielding Hunter starting melee from range, recording combat log timestamps.
tests.measure: Time from the first main-hand swing to the first off-hand swing.

stage_definitions.current-beta: An experiment within the current level-30 beta, subject to actual access, learned ranks and prerequisites. Sixteen Legacy Points and Dalaran expand opportunities, not the class talent budget or level-60 access.
stage_definitions.level30: Requires reachable level-30 abilities, talents and items. Check training, prerequisite rows and Legacy access; do not invent a new 51-point allocation.
stage_definitions.launch: Requires access beyond the announced level-30 beta or max-level content. Reclassify if later beta access is announced.
stage_definitions.offline: Client data, source research, code inspection or simulator testing; no game experiment is required.
